palette.notes: Digital painting in Procreate filmed off a tablet; code palette_size 6 is a misleading quantisation of camera video. Final art: Sprite brand greens and lemon yellow with warm brown skin tones.

lighting: Soft flat cel shading on the character; warm room light on the tablet.
silhouette: Stylised woman with big curly hair, lemon earrings and a striped crop top; strong hair shape frames the face.

motion.timing: Code: median hold 33.3 ms, 27.7 changes/s: camera video plus timelapse of drawing; no frame animation.

texture: Smooth vector-like brushwork, clean line art, light grain on the background.
camera: Handheld phone over the tablet; title card, brand logo reference, sketch, lineart, colour, final with logo-styled name.

acting.enters: Opens on a hand-lettered title 'Drawing food & drinks as people'.
acting.acts: Shows the reference logo, then sketch-to-final timelapse of the character.
acting.exits: Ends on the finished character with 'SPRITE' lettering.

techniques: sketch to line to colour timelapse
brand colours mapped onto a character
feel: NOT PIXEL ART: Procreate digital painting; brand-as-person concept + reference-to-final timelapse = quick payoff.
for_fred: Nothing for pixel craft; the idea of showing the 'reference' first then the transformed result works as a reel beat (show the plain logo, then Fred becoming it).
